abilities.name: Mark for Death
abilities.text: Target an Enemy Unit on the battlefield. When a Friendly Unit makes an Attack targeting that Unit, its first Melee or Ranged Weapon used gains CRITICAL HIT (1) and PRECISION (1).

abilities.name: Our Duty is Unending
abilities.text: Once per Game. Select up to two of your Exhausted Tactical Cards. Return them to the Ready state.

abilities.name: Khassar de Templari
abilities.text: Instead of performing an action, select one other Friendly Biological Unit that has already been Activated this Phase. That Unit immediately performs one action available in the current Phase, then suffers NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (3).

abilities.name: Instinctive Reaction
abilities.text: Use when an Enemy Unit declares a Close Combat Attack against a Friendly Unit. That Friendly Unit becomes eligible to make an Evade Roll against that attack.

abilities.name: Zerg Creep
abilities.text: During Army Building, select exactly one Creep Card and add it to their Army List, paying its listed cost (if any).

abilities.name: Scourge Queen
abilities.text: If the active Unit contains more models than the combined number of models in all Engaged Enemy Units, its Close Combat Weapons gain INSTANT and PRECISION (4).

abilities.name: Poisonous Essence
abilities.text: Set a Faction Indicator on the active Friendly Unit. At the end of the Assault Phase, all Biological Enemy Units Engaged with the marked Unit suffer NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (2).

abilities.name: Tunnel Network
abilities.text: The active, Unengaged Ground Unit is returned to Reserves instead of performing an action.

abilities.name: Reactive Tissue
abilities.text: While a Friendly Zerg Unit is ON CREEP, it gains DODGE (1) against any attacks targeting it.

abilities.name: Living Glob of Tissue
abilities.text: Creep Tumor tokens have STAY IN PLAY and DISPLACEMENT.

abilities.name: Creep Removal
abilities.text: If an Enemy Unit ends a Move, Deploy, Run, Charge or Disengage action Within 1" of a Friendly Creep Tumor token, remove that token from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Crystalline Alloy
abilities.text: Use before a Friendly Mechanical Unit makes an Armour Roll. That Unit gains DODGE (2) for this roll.

abilities.name: Ancestral Wisdom
abilities.text: Once per Round, when a Friendly Support Unit activates a Special Ability that costs PE, resolve that ability with its PE cost reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0). Do not Exhaust this card.

mission_parameters: Split the Battlefield in four quarters as shown on the Deployment Card.
scoring: Score VPs equal to Enemy Supply destroyed this Round.
FROM THE START OF THE FIRST ROUND:
Calculate Total Current Supply in each battlefield quarter.
Gain 1 VP for each quarter where your Total Current Supply is higher than the Opponent's.
Only Units Wholly Within a quarter contribute their Supply to this check.
If a Unit controls a Mission Marker, that Unit is worth 1 extra Supply for controlling quarters.
Gain 2 VP for Controlling Mission Marker 5.

Score VPs equal to Enemy Supply destroyed this Round.
END OF ROUND 5: Gain 4 VP for each Friendly Unit that CLAIM Mission Marker and it is Wholly Within Friendly Zone of Influence.
Gain 2 VP for each Mission Marker associated with your colour that is not currently CLAIM by an Enemy Unit.
additional: SCORING PHASE: From the Start of the Second Round, if a Unit is Within 3" of a Controlled Mission Marker that is Neutral or associated with the Opponent colour, that Unit may CLAIM it.

CLAIM: Place the Mission Marker on the Unit Card. A Unit carrying a Mission Marker must DROP it if: it has its Current Supply Value reduced; before it resolves a PLACE effect; it is Engaged with Enemies having a greater combined Current Supply Value; it is Destroyed, removed from the battlefield, or returned to Reserves.
When a Unit DROP a Mission Marker, the Opponent places the Mission Marker Within 2" of the Unit or its last model removed.
Unit may CLAIM only one Mission Marker at a time.

mission_parameters: During battlefield setup, place a D6 next to each Mission Marker to track its Sabotage Level. Set the starting Sabotage Level of each Mission Marker to 1.
scoring: Score VPs equal to Enemy Supply destroyed this Round.
FROM THE START OF THE SECOND ROUND:
Gain VP for each Controlled Mission Marker that is Neutral or associated with the Opponent colour. The VP gained is equal to the Sabotage Level on the marker.
Sabotage Level 3 = 3 VP
Sabotage Level 2 = 2 VP
Sabotage Level 1 = 1 VP
additional: ASSAULT PHASE: If an Unengaged Unit is Within 3" of a Controlled Mission Marker, this unit may perform Sabotage Action instead of a standard action.
Sabotage Action: Decrease or Increase that Mission Marker's Sabotage Level by 1 (to a minimum of 1 or maximum of 3).
